package.description: Relative path from project root to stack-kit package

compose.description: Consumer compose catalog and generated artifact paths

stack.description: Full-stack compose, remote deploy module list, and infra wiring

composeDir.description: Generated full-stack compose output dir (default: ops/compose/stack)

networkName.description: Default Docker network for stack + infra (overridable via DOCKER_NETWORK in deploy.env)

primaryApiModule.description: The module id the stack's API is (default: the first module whose role is api)

composeModules.description: Module ids for stack compose-gen and stack-deploy auto-steps (default: all modules)

deployBaseSecretsModule.description: Secrets module id for shared DEPLOY_PATH/DEPLOY_LAYOUT (structured java-boot runtime base). Worker modules (retrieval, ingestion) inherit when their .env.deploy omits DEPLOY_PATH.

modules.description: Optional filter for stack endpoint hints only (stack-kit stack up URLs); default: all catalog roles

composeNaming.description: Compose service keys from modules.* via compose_identity (deploy.env COMPOSE_* = legacy overrides only)

infra.description: Data-store modules for stack-kit infra (agnostic; consumer owns yaml)

services.description: Module ids → services/<id>.yml merged with docker-compose.base.yml

composeFiles.description: Full override: explicit -f list relative to infraComposeDir

aliases.description: Shortcut → modules.<id> (e.g. w → web, a → api)

modules.description: Module ids for remote stack-deploy (default: stack.composeModules, then all modules)

steps.description: Explicit deploy steps; omit to auto-generate from stack.composeModules (role order: api, worker, ui)

migrations.description: Where this module's migrations are when not under its own tree, and files allowed to carry reference data (ADR-001 decision 4: migrations are structure-only)

check.description: Environment variables the module's pre-flight check requires or reports as optional; the project names its own integrations (ADR-001)

type.description: Driver id from drivers/registry.json (e.g. java-boot, node-vite)

role.description: Logical role for stack order, layout, and default CLI shortcuts

path.description: App source dir relative to project root (e.g. apps/backend)

secretsModule.description: Folder under secrets root for ops/config (often same as module id)

credentials.description: Credential files under secretsModule (overrides global adapters.gcp for this module)

scripts.description: Deprecated — use package drivers; optional wrapper path only

target.description: Compose service name slug (e.g. module `search` → `<slug>-search`). NOT a server filesystem path under structured layout — JAR deploy uses stack.deployBaseSecretsModule DEPLOY_PATH + runtime/<container>/.

compose.description: Compose-gen options (P0-kit-13 embeddedWorker replaces catalog features.worker)

embeddedWorker.description: Legacy apps/backend/worker sidecar next to primary api module

debug.description: VS Code Run and Debug (optional; java-boot auto-detects *Application.java)

project.description: Project file relative to the module path; default: the single *.csproj there

configuration.description: dotnet publish configuration for deploy artifact

publishExpect.description: Paths that must exist in the publish output (e.g. Api.dll, web.config, wwwroot/index.html)

hybrid.description: Local host run (stack-kit hybrid boot / module run); springProfiles, gradleWrapper, npmScript

gradleWrapper.description: Path to gradlew relative to project root when not in module path

npmScript.description: npm script for node-vite (default: debug.npmScript or dev)

preferJar.description: Prefer pre-built JAR over Gradle bootRun for faster startup (requires bootJar)

bootJar.description: Path to pre-built Spring Boot JAR for hybrid preferJar mode

managementEndpoints.description: Spring actuator web exposure include list. Kit default is the narrow 'health,info' — a wider management surface is DECLARED, never a default.

envProfiles.description: env-profiles mode: local/dev/prod → secrets env file

profileYml.description: env-profiles only: YAML this module adds to every generated profile (its own integrations and loggers); the kit adds none

prebuildScripts.description: Workspace pnpm/npm scripts that must build before this module's package, in order. Absent or empty = nothing runs.

extensions.description: This module's own configuration, by name, for the host's tools: the kit validates its shape as an object and reads nothing in it

hybrid.description: P0-infra-07 hybrid compound (tunnel preLaunch + API + UI)

migration.description: One-time layout migration inputs (P6-migrate); project-specific legacy server state, not kit machinery

legacyDirs.description: Pre-migration flat folder names on the existing server, by role. Consumed by migrate-layout to build the old→new rename map. Omit for greenfield (no prior server).

api.description: Legacy flat dir names that map to the primary api module's compose service

ui.description: Legacy flat dir names that map to the primary ui module's compose service

bootOrder.description: Module roles in the order `dev up all` boots them. Absent = ["api", "worker", "ui"].

features.description: Optional project capabilities (package reads; defaults off in scaffold)

drivers.description: The project's own drivers (ADR-001 decision 7), composed with the kit's; an id the kit already has is refused

registry.description: Project-relative path of a registry in the kit's shape; each driver lives in <registry dir>/<id>/

keys.description: Project-relative path of the key catalogue (shape: config/config-keys.schema.json); validate refuses a SECRET with a committed value

validate.description: The proof `stack-kit validate --stages` runs: fail-fast stages against the real stack, ending on value anchors (ADR-001 decision 4). The anchor rule is lib/pipeline.py's.

run.description: argv, run from the project root (or cwd); no shell

expect.description: Anchor only: exactly one comparison with the command's stripped stdout

layout.description: The host's tree as a declared layout, held as a floor by `stack-kit validate` (ADR-001 decision 3). Places the manifest already declares (package, secrets, module paths, compose catalog, ci scripts, infra compose dir, nginx template, config.keys, vscode.cliScript) are rows without being listed here.

path.description: Root-relative, POSIX-formed; a directory ends in '/'

holds.description: The kind of truth that lives here

read_when.description: The task words that pull this place into context

pending.description: The work that gives this place content; its absence is then printed, not failed

closed.description: Directories the declaration is exhaustive at ('.' is the root): every tracked child must be covered by a row

scripts.description: The host's further CI scripts, by its own names: each a path the kit checks exists (validate) and holds as a layout-floor row; the kit names none of them
